notes: Official QFC public register of QFC-licensed firms, approved individuals, insolvency practitioners and official liquidators. Browser-public, no login/payment. ASP.NET page (publicregister.aspx) with __VIEWSTATE; results returned via search postback (grid empty on plain GET) — no clean GET/bulk/API. Covers ONLY QFC-licensed firms (financial centre), not onshore Qatari companies. Approved-individual names/addresses are personal data.

source_name: Ministry of Commerce and Industry — Commercial Registration
notes: MoCI is the onshore Qatari companies registry (the bulk of Qatari companies, keyed on the CR number). Main site reachable; e-service paths return 404 (portal restructured) and the Single Window host (businessinqatar.gov.qa / business.gov.qa) did not resolve. Verification is a per-CR lookup (often Arabic), commonly behind the national portal / authentication; no open bulk file or API was found. Field model documented from public knowledge only; no per-company values captured.

organization: Qatar Stock Exchange (QSE / Bourse de Doha)
notes: Qatar Stock Exchange listed-company directory, financial statements and disclosures. Browser-public (Liferay portal); data loaded via portlet AJAX, no clean open JSON API (guessed /api/markets/* endpoints 404). Listed companies only. Identifiers: QSE ticker symbol and ISIN (QA...).

Opendatasoft Explore v2.1 API works (1405 datasets) but the catalog is statistical (census, trade, sports, employment aggregates). No company/legal-entity register dataset found. Useful as confirmation that the open-data portal does not carry a company register.
